steps.name: write_file
steps.input:
{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u073/system/state/workspace/programs/task-3f488367.py",
 "content": "from collections import Counter, deque


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]

    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                comp.append((y, x, grid[y][x]))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and
                            (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] != background):
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        q.append((ny, nx))
            components.append(comp)

    template_comp = max(components, key=len)
    tr0 = min(p[0] for p in template_comp)
    tr1 = max(p[0] for p in template_comp)
    tc0 = min(p[1] for p in template_comp)
    tc1 = max(p[1] for p in template_comp)
    anchor = ((tr0 + tr1) // 2, (tc0 + tc1) // 2)
    template = [(r - anchor[0], c - anchor[1], color)
                for r, c, color in template_comp]

    candidates = [comp for comp in components if comp is not template_comp]
    target_color = Counter(p[2] for comp in candidates for p in comp).most_common(1)[0][0]
    targets = [(r, c) for comp in candidates for r, c, color in comp if color == target_color]

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in targets:
        for dy, dx, color in template:
            y, x = r + dy, c + dx
            if 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w:
                out[y][x] = color
    return out
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
